name: Perfect
overview: Scripture calls believers to pursue perfection as God is perfect, urging Christians to live with readiness and undivided devotion (Matthew 5:48; Luke 12:35; Luke 16:13). While all have sinned and fall short of God's glory (Romans 3:23), believers are encouraged to present themselves as living sacrifices and be transformed by renewing their minds to discern God's perfect will (Romans 12:1-2). This reflects both the challenge and the divine provision for growth toward spiritual maturity and holiness.
